class.name: hyu_rviz_presets/PerceptionStack
class.description: One-click group: live fusion cone detections (/cones/viz) as 3D cone meshes.

class.name: hyu_rviz_presets/SlamStack
class.description: One-click group: graph SLAM cone map, pose-graph path and ego odometry.

class.name: hyu_rviz_presets/PlanningStack
class.description: One-click group: global raceline (/global_waypoints/path) and local window (/path_waypoints/path).

class.name: hyu_rviz_presets/HudStack
class.description: One-click group: Path CTE / SLAM status / GNSS text HUD overlays (non-overlapping stack).

class.name: hyu_rviz_presets/FullStack
class.description: Everything at once: FSK Perception + SLAM + Planning + HUD groups.

class.name: hyu_rviz_presets/GnssModePanel
class.description: Buttons to set the simulated SBG Ellipse-D GNSS/RTK correction (rtk_fixed / rtk_float / single) and INS solution mode at runtime, by publishing to the sim_ellipse_d control topics.
